profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northwestern Mutual
profile.summary:
•	Around 12+ years of work experience in Information Technology with strong background in Data warehousing and ETL process.
•	Strong knowledge and familiarity with ETL Tool Informatica and extensively worked in data extraction, transformation and loading using Informatica.
•	Strong knowledge of database systems such as Oracle, MySQL, SQL server and DB2. 
•	Good hands on experience in SAFe, all Agile process and waterfall model. 
•	Acted as a Scrum Master in the team and managed team (15+ offshore) delivery along with development work.
•	Good domain knowledge in Insurance and Pharma.
•	Excellent analytical, problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to interact with individuals at all levels and can work as a part of a team as well as independently.
•	Good hands on experience in support projects, small/enhancement projects and Large projects.
